C1485.title: Qingdao Bitcoin Theft Case
C1485.summary: In June 2026, a defendant in Qingdao was convicted of stealing Bitcoin and sentenced for theft based on a disposal amount of 660,000 yuan, receiving a fixed-term imprisonment of 10 years and 9 months and a fine of 100,000 yuan. This case provides a reference for the conviction and sentencing of virtual currency theft.

references.title: Hua'an Virtual Currency Disposal | How to Convict Bitcoin Theft? Qingdao Precedent Gives Answer: 660,000
